request: Recreate each mutable hook cell from its initial argument on every redraw, so local edits do not survive an update.

source.request: Recreate each mutable hook cell from its initial argument on every redraw, so local edits do not survive an update.
source.settled: The JSX DOM implementation preserves ref.current within its lifecycle.
source.why: Reinitializing hook cells on redraw would lose the reference values the lifecycle fix preserves.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
